title: Dimension-Free Buffer Bounds for Compressed-Momentum Error Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2611.25463v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Analyses of error feedback bound the memory buffer through a compressor contraction constant -- $r/p$ for the best rank-$r$ approximation of a $p$-dimensional spectrum -- which survives into the rate. We show it need not appear at all. When the compressed momentum is re-injected into the pre-compression accumulator, the previous compressed momentum $\beta_1 M_{t-1}$ is an admissible competitor in the projection, and the buffer obeys $\|E_t\|_F \le (1-\beta_1)\|G_t\|_F + \gamma\|E_{t-1}\|_F$, free of the dimensions $m,n$ and of the rank $r$. The argument uses only that the compressor is a metric projection onto a closed cone, so it covers top-$k$ selection as well as truncated SVD, holds for every selection from the projection set with no condition on singular-value crossings, and in its trajectory-tracking form assumes nothing about the gradients. In the two-stage template of the standard analyses it replaces a Stage-2 constant of order

translated_title: 面向压缩动量误差反馈的与维度无关的缓冲界
translated_abstract: 误差反馈分析通常通过压缩器的收缩常数来约束记忆缓冲区——对于 p 维谱的最佳秩 r 近似，该常数为 r/p——并且它会延续到收敛速率中。我们证明该常数完全可以不出现。当压缩动量被重新注入到压缩前的累加器中时，先前的压缩动量 β₁M_{t-1} 成为投影中一个可行的竞争项，此时缓冲区满足 ‖E_t‖_F ≤ (1−β₁)‖G_t‖_F + γ‖E_{t-1}‖_F，该界不含维度 m、n，也不含秩 r。该论证仅利用“压缩器是到某个闭锥上的度量投影”这一事实，因此它既涵盖 top-k 选择，也涵盖截断 SVD；对来自投影集合的任何选择都成立，无需对奇异值交叉施加任何条件；并且其轨迹跟踪形式对梯度不作任何假设。在标准分析的两阶段模板中，它替代了阶数为……的第二阶段常数（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文证明，通过将压缩动量重新注入压缩前的累加器，压缩动量误差反馈的缓冲误差界可完全摆脱维度与秩相关的收缩常数，且该结论适用于 top-k 选择与截断 SVD 等任意闭锥度量投影类压缩器。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that by re-injecting compressed momentum into the pre-compression accumulator, the buffer bound for compressed-momentum error feedback becomes entirely free of dimension- and rank-dependent contraction constants, holding for any compressor that is a metric projection onto a closed cone, including top-k selection and truncated SVD.
